tooltip.hollowdread.tome: Reading it costs more than you think.
tooltip.hollowdread.doll: Its eyes follow you. Drains sanity while carried.
tooltip.hollowdread.lantern: Hold it to steady your mind. Crawlers fear it. Repair with glowstone dust.
message.hollowdread.tome.1: It wears the faces of those who looked too long.
message.hollowdread.tome.2: Three knocks. The first is a warning. The second is a question. The third is an answer.
message.hollowdread.tome.3: The dark is not the absence of light. It is the presence of something patient.
whisper.hollowdread.4: you were never alone in here
message.hollowdread.tome.4: Light a candle and it will hate you a little less.
message.hollowdread.tome.5: If it stops moving, it is because you are watching. Never blink.
whisper.hollowdread.6: wake up, wake up, wake up
message.hollowdread.tome.6: The doll was a gift. The doll does not forget who gave it.
message.hollowdread.tome.7: Below the deepest stone, something has been dreaming of you.
message.hollowdread.tome.8: Count the exits. There is always one fewer than you counted.
